items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: But he and Scoville both played with the Rhythm Kings.

ctx.x: Tinny Scoville, Glenn Scoville, was another tenor player who was a contemporary of Don Murray's. Don Murray used to play a scene melody in a Presbyterian church in Evanston. That's how he got started. And then he changed to clarinet when he joined Go Cat. But he and Scoville both played with the Rhythm Kings.
